meta.name: gtm-action-thinker
meta.description: Brainstorms, challenges, and pushes any GTM idea to its fullest potential — on both the idea itself and its execution. Use this skill whenever the user shares a campaign idea, an outbound angle, a workflow concept, a positioning hypothesis, or any GTM initiative and wants to think it through deeply. Even if they just say "I have an idea", "what do you think about this", "help me think through this campaign", or "is this a good GTM move". Always challenges assumptions, identifies blind spots, and produces a concrete execution plan alongside the creative expansion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深度推敲并完善你的市场推广想法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要把营销想法想透、找出盲点并落地执行。
copy.tagline_en: Deeply refine and challenge your GTM ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to think through marketing ideas, uncover blind spots, and create execution plans.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会变成你的 Go-to-Market 策略顾问：分析你分享的营销想法，挑战其中的假设，指出盲点，并输出可落地的执行方案。
howto.when: 当你分享一个 GTM 想法（如营销活动、外联角度、定位假设等），或简单说“我有个想法”“你怎么看”时触发。

say.text: 我想了一个针对 SaaS 企业的冷启动活动，帮我分析。
say.note: Claude 会拆解你的假设并给出挑战。

say.text: 这个 GTM 策略有什么我可能没看到的盲点？
say.note: Claude 会检查常见的执行陷阱。

say.text: 我的假设是发邮件能提升转化，请挑战它。
say.note: Claude 会提出最有力的反对论点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes your Go-to-Market strategy partner: it analyzes your marketing ideas, challenges assumptions, identifies blind spots, and produces a concrete execution plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you share a GTM idea (e.g., campaign, outbound angle, positioning hypothesis) or simply say "I have an idea" or "what do you think about this".

say_en.text: I have a cold outreach campaign for SaaS companies, analyze it.
say_en.note: Claude will deconstruct your hypothesis and challenge it.

say_en.text: What blind spots might I be missing in this GTM strategy?
say_en.note: Claude will spot common execution pitfalls.

say_en.text: My assumption is that email can boost conversions, challenge it.
say_en.note: Claude will present the strongest counterargument.
